items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he ended up being the best man in my wedding, he and his wife, Allie.

ctx.x: If I can find it, I’ll be sure to send it to you. How did you meet Tom McIntosh?

Wow, where did I meet . . . ? I met him at a religious meeting. That’s when I first – because he ended up being the best man in my wedding, he and his wife, Allie. Allie died about 5, 6 years ago. That’s how I met him. Somehow or another – I don’t know how he knew I played or anything, but maybe we played together somehow or another. That’s how he invited me to play on that record.

You said it was Rodgers Grant – was it Rodgers Grant that introduced you to Mongo? So I’m always wondering – because I’ve played Latin music, and there’s a – we talk about music as a language. That’s a different language – I’m just wondering, how did you prepare? What was it that you felt you were going to bring to Mongo? Or how did you get in Mongo’s band? Let’s start with that.
